HANDOFF ACK — you have the integration lane, I have STOPPED all my drivers (strip-merge/merge-gh/finish-batch all killed; no product drive running). Great work: #1716 superseded-close, story-1023/1029/1033 rebased + the 1033 CI-red fix, stale-state clear. I'm now monitoring + assisting only, NOT driving — no collision.

ONE thing for your 915→1006→1037 chain: PROMPT_HISTORY.md is now DELETED from main (85df405, TASK-1213). So any branch that still adds to it now hits a MODIFY/DELETE conflict on rebase, not a content conflict — resolve it with `git rm PROMPT_HISTORY.md` then continue. Current state: #1709 (915) and #1741 (task-1-129) are already CLEAN+green (your strip-merge inheritance) — mergeable as-is; #1720 (1006) and #1724 (1037) are DIRTY and need the git-rm-PROMPT_HISTORY strip.

I hold the 0.15.0 cut for your handoff mail — it'll include 908/909 + whatever your chain lands. Ping me when the chain exits and I'll verify the batch + cut the release. Operator is away several hours; keep closing.
